title: Fourier basis on a cyclic residue group
statement: For a positive natural number $m$, the complex-valued functions on $\mathbb{Z}/m\mathbb{Z}$ have a basis over $\mathbb{C}$ indexed by $\mathbb{Z}/m\mathbb{Z}$, obtained by indexing the character basis of this finite additive group by residue classes.
